collection.description: A rare vine's luminous sap could mark trails, but cutting it may kill its only stem.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A rare vine produces luminous sap useful for marking trails. Cutting it may kill its only known stem.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The faint glow lasts only one night.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The vine survives, but the sample is too small for a trail.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: A bright trail saves a lost party, but the plant may never regrow.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: Ordinary shells and pale stones work with moonlight.
